svg.title: One branch can help another.
svg.desc: The same source attribution shown as a family tree. Alice is parent to Bob and Carol; Bob is parent to Dana. Dana’s holdings attribute three hundred credits, of which she retains two hundred forty. Bob earns thirty direct referral credits. Alice earns thirty, retains fifteen, and shares fifteen. With one hundred credits escrowed by Bob and two hundred by Carol, Bob receives five family credits and Carol ten. Final allocations attributable to this source are Alice fifteen, Bob thirty-five, Carol ten, and Dana two hundred forty: three hundred total. Carol benefits from Dana’s holdings although Dana is outside Carol’s downline.

g.text: Family sharing connects the interests of sibling branches.
Following the same 300-credit attribution from Dana’s holdings
Gray lines: parent links. Gold arrows: Alice’s family allocation. Bob shares 0%.
Carol receives part of the commission from Dana’s holdings.
Dana belongs to Bob’s branch, outside Carol’s own downline.
